cases.notes: Static AWS key mode; not role assumption or service-account provisioning. Dummy credentials only. Persistence fixture, never Test Config, sync, or endpoint creation; AWS SDK use would contact real AWS APIs. All create operations may emit configured backend metrics/activity notifications.
Azure application/client-secret mode. Dummy tenant and application IDs; persistence only. Authentication or validation would contact Microsoft cloud endpoints.

Tenant-scoped OAuth client-secret mode. Backend create also stores a disabled workspace login method with auto-sync and role-sync disabled; do not enable login or sync. Persistence only, not authentication.
Password authentication with TLS required. Plain CockroachDB maps CA material via tls_root_cert, not root_cert; certificate fields intentionally omitted. Persistence only.
Service-account JSON key mode; key_file is credential content, not a filename. Deliberately nonfunctional synthetic private key. Persistence only, not SDK credential validation.
OAuth client-secret mode, not delegated directory service-account mode. Backend create stores a disabled login method; do not enable login, directory sync, or role sync. Persistence only.
Password authentication embedded in sensitive uri, TLS enabled. No X.509 client certificate. Persistence only; do not connect.

AWS Secrets Manager reference mode. ARN is the dummy IAM role reference; do not invent host/password inputs for this builder. Optional key omitted. No plaintext secret is resolved by this fixture; runtime secret resolution would call AWS.
Password mode explicitly excludes RDS IAM. MySQL uses required, not the PostgreSQL require spelling, for this fixture. No client certificates. Persistence only.
Secrets Manager reference mode, dummy role and secret ID. This builder maps no direct database password or host. Persistence only; secret retrieval would call AWS.
OAuth client-secret mode. Backend create stores a disabled workspace login method; leave login, auto-sync, and role-sync disabled. Persistence only.
Password mode explicitly excludes RDS IAM and credential discovery. TLS required, no client certificates. Persistence only; existing backend connection validators are not safe save-time probes.
Secrets Manager reference mode with no direct password input in this builder. Persistence only; resolving the dummy reference would call AWS, so never run Test Config.

TLS service-list mode; provider type services maps to backend servicelist. This builder exposes no authentication secret. URLs are stored configuration, not Adaptive endpoint resources. Persistence only.
Password-based server-list access, no SSH key. hosts is a provider list serialized to newline-separated backend hosts. Persistence only; no SSH sessions.
Password SSH mode is derived from absent key; use_password is not a provider input. Persistence only, no SSH sessions.
Bearer-token Kubernetes mode; cluster CA omitted rather than supplying a malformed certificate. Persistence only: do not Test Config, select as a default/access cluster, or launch pods/endpoints.
Password in sensitive Mongo-compatible URI, TLS enabled via tls_enabled (not use_tls). Persistence only, no DocumentDB connections.
Database password mode, not IAM. Builder uses host, not hostname. TLS required. Persistence only.
API-token mode; provider zerotier maps to backend zero_tier. No configurable API host, so .invalid cannot fence runtime API calls. Persistence only; never join networks or validate the token.
Windows username/password mode, file transfer explicitly disabled. Persistence only, no remote-desktop endpoint or session.
Per-target Windows username/password mode. targets is a nested provider block list, serialized as YAML; nested port is integer unlike top-level port. Persistence only, no fleet session or endpoint.

Atlas API public/private key pair plus database URI credentials. Dummy organization/project identifiers. Atlas API uses its own cloud host; persistence only, never discover databases or test credentials.
AWS role-based Secrets Manager integration; this builder maps aws_arn and aws_region_name, not arn/region/secret_id. No inline secret field. Persistence only, no AWS calls.
SQL username/password mode. Builder uses host, not hostname. Persistence only.
SQL password mode, not Azure managed identity. This builder requires nonempty hostname, port, username, password, database_name, and caller-supplied resource name. Persistence only.

HEC token mode using url (not uri). Configuring this resource does not itself prove it is a notification destination; global backend activity sinks may independently emit on any create. Persistence only, never send test events.
API/application key pair; app_key maps dd_app_key. dd_site is synthetic, not a supported real Datadog site. Persistence only, not API validation.
Secrets Manager reference mode; no direct SQL credentials in this builder. Persistence only; secret retrieval would call AWS.
Coralogix private API key mode; URI maps backend url. Persistence only, no log delivery or test event. Existing global event sinks remain independent of this dummy resource.
OAuth client secret plus directory API key. Backend create stores a disabled login method; do not enable login or directory/role sync. Runtime API calls may use fixed vendor hosts. Persistence only.
Teams application secret mode; client_id/client_secret map appId/appKey. Persistence only, not message delivery or Microsoft token acquisition.
Password mode; this builder maps host but no database_name. Root certificate intentionally omitted. Persistence only.
OAuth and API client-secret pairs. Backend create stores a disabled login method; leave login, auto-sync, and role-sync disabled. Persistence only.
HTTP username/password mode. uri maps backend url. Persistence only, no indexing or connectivity test.
SSH password mode derives from absent key, with separately stored web UI URL. No browser automation or scripts configured. Persistence only, no device sessions.
SSH password mode, no key or automation. uri is the public input mapping backend login_url; login_url is explicitly rejected for this type. Persistence only.
SSH password mode. uri maps backend login_url; do not substitute the rejected login_url provider input. No browser automation or proxy. Persistence only.
Password mode; hostname maps databaseAccount, not a generic TCP host. Key-pair clientcert omitted. Snowflake may derive a real vendor hostname from account input if used; persistence only.
Secrets Manager reference mode. No direct Snowflake password mapped by this builder; persistence only, no AWS secret resolution.
Shared-secret webhook mode; uri maps url. Persistence only, no webhook delivery. Backend creation events can independently use existing global notification sinks.
SSH password mode derived from absent key, with web UI configuration. No browser automation or script. Persistence only.
SSH password mode. host is the canonical provider alias for backend hostname; do not configure both aliases. No browser automation. Persistence only.
SSH password mode. uri maps backend login_url and public login_url is rejected for this type. No automation or proxy. Persistence only.
Plain TCP syslog, no authentication secret in this mode. TLS CA/client certificate/key fields deliberately omitted. Persistence only, no log delivery.
Workload service-account reference; builder exposes no inline secret. Image registry is .invalid. Persistence only: never create a pod, pull image, or create endpoint.
Password mode with use_tls; ssl_mode is not this builder's TLS control. Persistence only.
Static AWS key mode, no role assumption or service-account provisioning. Correct builder names are keyspaces_endpoint and aws_region_name. Persistence only, no keyspace discovery or AWS calls.
Management UI username/password mode; uri maps backend url. Persistence only, no broker or management API connection.
Cosmos account-key mode: api_token maps key, uri maps endpoint. Base64 dummy account key, not a real credential. Persistence only.
Webhook URL is the credential-bearing field; no separate secret is exposed by this builder. Persistence only, no message or workflow invocation.
Service-account token mode, not Connect Server mode; connect_server_url omitted. API host is not configurable in this mode. Persistence only, no 1Password SDK calls.
Opaque sensitive value persistence; no network authentication mode or connection host exists in this builder. Synthetic plaintext only.
Managed desktop sizing only; builder exposes no authentication secret. Persistence only: never create a desktop workload, endpoint, or session.
OAuth client-secret mode. No configurable API host; runtime authentication would reach vendor endpoints. Persistence only, no EDR API tests.
AWS role-reference mode; builder has no inline AWS key. aws_region_name maps aws_region. Persistence only, no CloudWatch delivery or stream creation.

Redis username/password mode, IAM disabled. Preserve the provider's accepted awselasticcache spelling. No AWS credentials, access-control provisioning, or IAM token generation configured. Persistence only.
Secrets Manager reference mode with TLS enabled. Preserve accepted singular secret spelling in this type token. Persistence only, no secret retrieval or database connection.
Cosmos Mongo-compatible URI password mode; builder exposes only uri beyond name/version. Persistence only, no connection.

Service-account JSON credential mode. Project and fake key are inside credential_json; no separate project_id mapping exists in this builder. Deliberately nonfunctional key; persistence only, no SDK validation.

Unconfigured browser authentication; synthetic empty form-fields document exercises a sensitive mapped input without executable script or prestart command. Persistence only, no browser launch or endpoint.

Secrets Manager reference plus direct database fields: this builder really maps both (unlike most other secret-manager variants). Dummy password exercises secret persistence. Persistence only, no AWS calls or connections.
Confluent username/password and API key/secret fields are independently mapped. No configurable API host. Persistence only, no discovery or vendor API validation.
DigitalOcean API-token mode. No configurable API host or other nonsecret setting beyond caller resource name. Persistence only, no cloud discovery.
Shared Fortinet appliance builder, SSH password mode derived from absent key. No browser automation. Persistence only.
Shared Fortinet appliance builder, SSH password mode derived from absent key. No browser automation. Persistence only.
Heroku machine/username/token mode. machine is a configuration value, not a guarantee that cloud SDK traffic is fenced. Persistence only, no API discovery.
SSH password mode, absent key; no browser automation or proxy. Persistence only, no device session.
Shared SSH appliance builder, password mode. Browser policy fields omitted rather than creating automated login behavior. Persistence only.

attributes.client_configuration:
bootstrap.servers=tf-live.invalid:9093
security.protocol=SASL_SSL
sasl.mechanism=PLAIN
sasl.jaas.config=org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required username="tf_live" password="tf-live-dummy-password";

cases.notes: SASL/PLAIN password in sensitive properties-format client_configuration. MSK IAM explicitly disabled; do not invent top-level username/password mappings for this builder. Persistence only, no broker connection.
LDAPS search-bind password mode. Backend create stores a disabled login method; do not enable authentication, auto-sync, or role-sync. Persistence only, no directory queries.
DigitalOcean managed MongoDB API-token mode; database_name maps dbName. No host/uri mapping exists in this builder, so cloud discovery would use real vendor API hosts. Persistence only.
MongoDB 3.6 URI password mode with TLS, no client certificate. version is a builder constant here, not an accepted configurable version control. Persistence only.
Oracle service-name/password mode. service_name is the actual mapped input, not database_name. Persistence only.

Separate data-plane and admin username/password pairs; no client certificates. Explicit native required SSL mode is accepted by both Terraform and CLI creation; legacy require remains literal for compatibility but cannot be cloned through the CLI form route. Persistence only, no ProxySQL admin mutations or database connections.
LDAP search-bind password plus RDP target address. This builder maps no top-level RDP username/password. Persistence only, no LDAP authentication or RDP session.
Redis ACL username/password mode, TLS enabled, no mutual TLS material. Persistence only, no Redis commands or connection tests.
Name-only builder: caller must supply resource name. There are no mapped host, authentication, or secret inputs; do not invent them. Persistence only, never establish a tunnel or create an endpoint.
Webhook URL and API token are both mapped credential inputs. Persistence only, no messages or webhook tests. Existing global backend event notifications are a separate possible outbound path.
Shared SSH appliance builder, password mode derived from absent key. Browser automation omitted. Persistence only.
VNC password mode; hosts is a provider list, serialized as newline-separated hosts. No username mapping in this builder. Persistence only, no desktop session.
Windows fleet username/password mode; hosts is a list serialized to newline-separated backend hosts. Preserve the accepted hyphenated type token. Persistence only, no endpoint or RDP session.
